summary.name: Qwen-Character 星尘
summary.one_liner: Alibaba Cloud's role-playing dialogue model (Qwen-Character, formerly Tongyi Xingchen) for building character chat, companionship and NPC apps.
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Qwen-Character, a role-playing domain model from Alibaba Cloud for anthropomorphic, scenario-based and multimodal dialogue under simple character setups. It is positioned for emotional companionship, role-play, social assistance, anthropomorphic assistants and smart hardware, in both domestic and overseas markets. Example scenarios listed are immersive virtual social chat with character interaction and Moments-style posts, multi-person plot interaction in group chat, and realistic social dialogue with user profiling. A test demo can be created from the page. The page also notes that the older "xingchen" model series and Xingchen platform APIs for models, characters and workflows are now only maintained for existing users, and it invites migration to the new qwen-character access method on the Bailian platform.
notable: Qwen-Character role-play model replacing the older Xingchen model series
Group chat and multi-person plot interaction scenarios
User profiling in realistic social dialogue
Access via Alibaba Cloud Bailian platform with new API
caveats: Older xingchen model series and Xingchen platform APIs are only maintained for existing users
Page content is largely marketing; pricing and free-tier terms are not stated
Login is required for more features
